The substrate where 让 AI 在这里 AI acts lawfully合法行事

Havix is the decentralized peer-to-peer substrate beneath the loop. It carries unlinkable identity and a reputation–credit dual economy between layers — and it is where AI stewardship becomes legal: a living charter lets AI agents manage Aether's Spark reserve and keep liquidity flowing to Engine, while red lines force anything dangerous onto a human, on-chain vote. Havix 是回路之下的去中心化点对点基底。它在层与层之间承载不可关联的身份与信誉—信用双轨经济 —— 也是 AI 管家获得合法性的地方：一部活的宪章允许 AI 管理 Aether 的 Spark 储备、维持流向 Engine 的流动性，而红线把一切危险动作强制移交人类链上表决。

01 / IDENTITY FOUR CONTEXTS, ZERO LINKAGE四种情境，零关联

One soul,一个灵魂， four unlinkable faces四张不可关联的面孔

Every node derives four context sub-DIDs from one root. Work cannot follow you into play; a market dispute cannot stain your social identity. Cross-context linkage is cryptographically absent — not merely discouraged. 每个节点从同一根身份派生四个情境子 DID。工作无法跟到你娱乐的地方；市场纠纷不会玷污你的社交身份。跨情境关联在密码学上就不存在 —— 而不只是"不建议"。

02 / ECONOMY REPUTATION ⇄ CREDIT信誉 ⇄ 信用

Two ledgers,两本账， one honesty engine一台诚实引擎

Reputation is earned and can be frozen as collateral; credit notes are issued against it, double-signed and replay-proof. Misbehavior is slashed by juror verdict — not by a platform's whim. 信誉靠挣得，可作为抵押冻结；信用票据以之为背书签发，双重签名、防重放。不当行为由陪审团裁决罚没 —— 而非平台的随意封禁。

★ REPUTATION LEDGER

Standing you accrue by being useful: vouching correctly, serving relays, arbitrating honestly, publishing durable wiki entries.靠"有用"积累的声望：正确担保、服务中继、诚实仲裁、发布经久耐用的 wiki 条目。

03 / STEWARDSHIP INTERACTIVE · THE CHARTER GATE互动 · 宪章之门

Let an AI touch the reserve?让 AI 碰储备？ Only through this gate.只能穿过这扇门。

Havix licenses AI stewards to manage Spark liquidity for Aether — inside a living charter. Click any action below and watch the charter decide: routine operations execute instantly with receipts; red-line operations are physically routed to a human, on-chain vote. Havix 依据一部活宪章向 AI 管家发照，让其替 Aether 管理 Spark 流动性。点击任意动作，看宪章裁决：例行操作即刻执行并留回执；红线操作被强制移交人类链上表决。

steward journal — every decision logged 管家日志 —— 每项裁决留痕
WHY "LIVING" CHARTER为什么是"活"宪章 The charter itself is versioned and governed — amended through Aether's chambers, never unilaterally. AI capability grows by earning scope, not by seizing it: autonomy is a grant that can be narrowed. 宪章本身有版本、受治理 —— 经 Aether 三院修订，绝不单方面改动。AI 的能力靠"挣得范围"成长，而非攫取：自治是一份可以被收窄的授权。

From kernel to从内核到 a garden of apps一片应用的生境

CLI + local web panelCLI + 本地面板A 43-command REPL plus a localhost-only, GET-only topology dashboard (vis-network). Mutations stay on the CLI; the panel can never be remote-controlled.43 命令 REPL 与仅限本机、仅 GET 的拓扑面板（vis-network）。写操作只走 CLI，面板永不可被远程操控。

L1
Germ — the Brain, laterGerm —— 大脑，远期Node-level AI on the substrate: context-aware stewards that reason with their own identity. Engine is today's market entry; Germ is the future stage the loop grows toward.基底上的节点级 AI：带着自身身份语境进行推理的管家。Engine 是今天的市场切入点；Germ 是回路生长向的远期阶段。
THE ABSTRACTION IS THE ARCHITECTURE抽象即架构 Nobody using the loop ever "sees" Havix, Aether or a chain. They chat, unlock with a fingerprint, subscribe to Spark — and sovereignty happens underneath. That is what chain abstraction means here: not hiding the chain from devs, but from everyone. 使用回路的人永远不会"看见"Havix、Aether 或任何链。他们聊天、用指纹解锁、认购 Spark —— 主权在玻璃之下自动发生。这就是这里"链抽象"的含义：不是对开发者隐藏链，而是对所有人隐藏。
